# Siri Solutions (sirisolutions.in)
> Rooted in Strategy. Powered by Innovation.

Siri Solutions is a full-service digital marketing, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), paid media, and web solutions agency headquartered in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India. The agency serves growing enterprises, D2C brands, and mid-market companies across India (Vijayawada, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Pune, Visakhapatnam) and international markets including the UAE.

## Core Capabilities
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Technical audits, on-page optimization, and high-intent keyword ranking.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Entity architecture and structured data for AI search discovery in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- Local SEO: Google Business Profile governance and regional multi-location local search prominence.
- Google Ads & Paid Search: Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns with offline conversion tracking.
- Meta Ads Management: High-converting Facebook & Instagram campaign funnels with Server-Side Conversions API (CAPI).
- Website Design & Development: Sub-2.0s Core Web Vitals, mobile-first responsive architecture, custom landing pages, and 100% client asset ownership.

## Verified Client Implementations
- Dandamudi Box Office (https://dandamudiboxoffice.com/): Official Film Production House Website Created.
- Dandamudi Biotech (https://dandamudibiotech.in/): Corporate Biotechnology, Organic Plantations & Bio-Extraction Web Platform Created.
- Silver Spring Realtors (https://silverspringrealtors.com/): Luxury Real Estate, Villas & Sky Towers Web Platform Created.
- Deccan Trails (https://www.deccantrails.com/): Search Engine Optimization (SEO Services) & Organic Search Traffic Growth for Adventure Resort & Camping.
